name: Online reputation manager
summary: Replies to reviews safely, earns more good ones the honest way and turns happy customers into proof. Spots repeat complaints before they spread.

changelog.note: First release: review monitoring, replies and policy flags on Google, Trustpilot, Yelp, Tripadvisor, Etsy and Google Play (each platform's own pages, dated); FTC reviews rule, CMA guidance under the DMCC Act and EU review rules; extortion and takedown routes; testimonials with CAP and GDPR consent; fresh yes for negative replies and legal requests; 30 checked sources.
